name: Guangdong Kingshine Electronic Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Guangdong Kingshine Electronic Technology Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of high-density printed circuit boards in China. It offers milimeter wave radar PCB, light module PCB, industrial control class PF PCB, switch PCB, server PCB, new energy, thick copper plate, HDI board, metal-based PCB and ceramic substrate. Its products are primarily used in consumer electronics, network communication devices, industrial fields, automotive electronics, computer, and other fields. The company was founded in 2001 and is based in Huizhou, China.
